title: Teams Premium: who needs the add-on licence, and what does it unlock?
summary: The page passes: Microsoft's documentation supports the licensing requirements, price, trial limits and governance controls. The flagged Graph calls and self-service setting labels are documented, and an independent search found no documented automation for approving Teams Premium licence requests.
